name: Crowd of Bullies [Combat, Selfless, Teamwork]
body:
Your failed attempt to humiliate a foe reveals its weaknesses to your allies.

Prerequisites: Half-orc.

Benefit(s): Whenever you fail a combat maneuver check, your allies within 30 feet gain a +2 circumstance bonus on combat maneuver checks of the same type against the same foe for 1 round.
